descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
The open road, from the driver's seat - in Arizona.

THE PHOENIX LOOP
47 miles of real Phoenix freeway built from real map data: Loop 202 past Sky Harbor, Tovrea Castle and Tempe Town Lake, Loop 101 north through Scottsdale and west across north Phoenix, then SR-51 through Dreamy Draw and the Phoenix Mountains. Real ramps, real overpasses, saguaros, palms and the desert all around.

A SHOW TRUCK TO CALL HOME
Walnut dash, cognac tufting, fourteen working gauges and a starlight headliner. Grip the wheel with your own hands, pull the air horn, set the parking brake - or drive with the joysticks.

A REAL 10-SPEED
Pick AUTOMATIC and just drive, or switch to MANUAL and float a 10-speed through the H-pattern with a LO/HI range. Match the revs and it drops in. Miss it and it grinds.

HAUL REAL ARIZONA LOADS
Six depots in real Valley places - Sky Harbor, Tempe Marketplace, the Mesa Riverview truck stop, Scottsdale Airpark, Desert Ridge and the Biltmore. Back under your trailer, take the load and deliver it through Phoenix traffic.

DAY AND NIGHT
Drive at noon or after dark with the Valley lit up. Night runs pay extra.

ON THE RADIO
A real dispatcher and five truckers on the CB with Arizona road talk.

THE SLEEPER
Leave the seat, walk back into the sleeper and sleep through to morning.

Plus 17 achievements, 9 paints and a live map.
